name: swarm of bats
desc: Swarm of Bats is a CR 0.25 beast.

actions.name: bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], 0 ft., one creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm}'s space. Hit: [[/damage 2d4 piercing average]] damage, or [[/damage 1d4 piercing average]] damage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has half of its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: swarm
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: echolocation
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can't use its &reference[blindsight] while &reference[deafened apply=false].

actions.name: keen hearing
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
